content: Rendering thresholds: SVG ~1,000 nodes before frame drops; Canvas2D comfortably handles up to ~10,000 objects/frame; WebGL handles 50,000+ instanced primitives per frame and is preferred beyond ~10,000 nodes. d3-force simulation itself (physics) is CPU-bound regardless of renderer; GPU-accelerated force calculation (cosmograph) is needed for 100k+ node force simulation, not just rendering.
